{{Quote|I was recruited by a man called Tyranus on one of the moons of Bogden.|Jango Fett|<ref name="Episode 2">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
'''Bogden''' was a many-mooned world located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], along the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], between [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]] and [[Ploo system/Legends|Ploo]].

==Description==
[[Orbit/Legends|Orbited]] by 20 [[Moon/Legends|moons]],<ref name="FDCR" /> Bogden suffered from the immense pressures of gravitational tides, and the planet's surface was literally pulled apart. The few who called Bogden home were forced to adapt to the shifting, seismic terrain, though most of Bogden's visitors were outlaws on the run, smugglers, or [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].

The Bogden system was known as a notable [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-[[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] system.<ref name="TEA" />

The planet was homeworld of giant [[renda bear]]s.<ref name="JH" />

==History==
Bogden joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] prior to the [[Indecta Era]]. During the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]], it supported [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

The planet once suffered a catastrophic war which lasted a thousand years. This interplanetary conflict for the control of the system devastated the orbit and surface of Bogden. The planet was now surrounded by a ring of debris of hundred of thousands destroyed starships and only ruins remained at the surface from the civilization that once inhabited the planet.<ref name="TCSWE" />

Eventually, the [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora]], led by [[Komari Vosa]], used Bogden's moon [[Kohlma]] as a base of operations for their plans of galactic domination. [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] was hired to [[The Hunt|track down]] Komari Vosa, and eventually discovered the war-ravaged moon. After the [[Mission to Kohlma|death of Vosa]], Jango was recruited by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to be the prime template for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Clone Army]] and the Bando Gora presumably collapsed. Shortly before his encounter with Komari Vosa, Jango defeated his rival, [[Montross (bounty hunter)|Montross]], and left him to face a grueling end at the hands of the Bando Gora cultists.<ref name="BH">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Bogden remained loyal to the Republic.<ref name="TEA" />

The planet was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] stronghold during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'', Bogden is erroneously called "Bodgen". The mistake was repeated again later until the correct spelling was confirmed in ''[[The Unseen Planets of Episode II]]''.

Bogden and the "Bogden sector" appeared in the preview for ''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]'' (published in ''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]'') but they were cut from the final version and respectively replaced by [[Contruum/Legends|Contruum]] and the [[Contruum system/Legends|Contruum system]].
